definitions.explanation: Considering something as a whole rather than focusing on individual parts. Used when making general assessments or describing broad tendencies.

examples.japanese: {全体的|ぜんたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{全体的|ぜんたいてき}な⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The overall impression was very good.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全体的|ぜんたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at sales overall, they are on an upward trend.

notes:
Very common in assessments, reviews, and summaries.

FORMS:
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な + noun (modifier: overall ~)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial: overall, on the whole)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (looking at it overall)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧ (overall impression)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (general tendency)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧ (overall evaluation)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧ (overall balance)

The adverbial form {全体的|ぜんたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is especially frequent, used like English "overall" or "generally."
